bagPolicy.summary: Each person can bring one small bag no larger than A4 size (297mm x 210mm x 210mm). Larger bags are refused entry.
allowed: One small bag per person up to 297mm high, 210mm wide and 210mm deep
prohibited: Bags folded over to reduce their size
bagPolicy.note: Bags are checked at an outer cordon and a bag gauge is used if size is in question. For concerts the stadium also refers fans to the promoter's rules, so check the event listing. No bag drop is mentioned.

parking.summary: A limited number of accessible parking passes go to ticket holders through the event organizer at least 5 working days before the event; for concerts, contact MCD Productions. Access to the parking facility closes 2 hours before the event starts due to road closures, and approach routes are printed on the back of the pass. Concert parking details may differ.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Aviva Stadium. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Official venue guidance says food and beverage concessions are available.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Concert tickets, including for guests with accessible needs, are sold by Ticketmaster (ticketmaster.ie or 1890 925100). Wheelchair users, guests with reduced mobility, and those with audio or visual impairments may be entitled to a personal assistant's ticket. There are 230 wheelchair places plus matching assistant seats on all levels, reached by lifts.

reEntry.summary: The reviewed official venue guidance does not state a specific re-entry policy.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Official venue guidance provides mobile or digital ticket instructions on the linked page.

gates.summary: Official venue guidance says doors or gates open 5 hours before the event time described on the linked page; special-event timing may vary.
